title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria - The student must correctly derive and present the energy levels of the hydrogen atom as E_n = -1/2 * (me^4 / (4πε_0)^2 * ħ^2 * n^2).

title: Coulomb's Law Application
description: Important Criteria - The student should correctly apply Coulomb's law to describe the force between the electron and the nucleus.

title: Angular Momentum Quantization
description: Important Criteria - The student must accurately state and apply the quantization condition for angular momentum, p_φ = nħ.

title: Doublet Structure Explanation
description: Essential Criteria - The student must provide a clear explanation of the doublet structure in sodium's optical spectra due to angular momentum coupling.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria - The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the energy expression derivation.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria - The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as constants, are included in the final expressions.
